column1: # The igBinary reader — the loader that turns a pack into an object graph.
# Curated, not generated: every name here comes from decompiling the function and
# reading it against the established facts about the
# object-section reader.  The class prefix is recovered, not invented — 0x002e95e0,
# the 17-section dispatch that calls all of these, is already `igIGBFile_ReadFile`.
# The chain, (each arrow is a `jal` in the matched C):
#          -> 0x002e7100          reads one object: first word = class index,
#                                 advance = its own field-reader byte count +
#     0x002e6090  parses the blob's 12-word header and maps word N -> a ctx slot
#     0x002e9f30  allocates the section buffer: ctx+0x108 = buffer,
